claude_proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.item_form
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing magic-item families fit, but multiple passive and reactive properties are gated by the weapon's current altered form rather than merely by holding or attunement.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "Acrobatic Assist (Quarterstaff and 10-Foot Pole Forms Only)." / "Attack Deflection (Quarterstaff Form Only)." / "Ranged Weapon (Quarterstaff Form Only)."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: emit_light
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item can be toggled to create a persistent dim-light radius. No current surface atom models authored light emission.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "you can cause it to emit green Dim Light out to 10 feet ... or you can extinguish the light"

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_weapon_profile
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The quarterstaff gains the Thrown property and a specific normal/long range only in one form. The current surface has no honest way to add weapon properties or swap attack profile data on an item.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "This weapon has the Thrown property with a normal range of 30 feet and a long range of 120 feet."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: return_item_after_attack
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The weapon automatically flies back to the wielder's hand after a ranged attack, which is a deterministic combat effect not represented by any current effect atom.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "Immediately after you make a ranged attack with the weapon, it flies back to your hand."
